statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The Holter monitor is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
The diagnoses are R55 and I47.1
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
The Holter study is medically necessary to detect transient cardiac arrhythmias responsible for the syncope episodes
